About Us

Amitytrans Techno

Instrument transformer manufacturers in India

Established in 2016 in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, Amitytrans Techno (I) Pvt. Ltd. (ATIPL) designs and manufactures instrument transformers for power distribution. Our range includes indoor and outdoor CTs, PTs/VTs and metering solutions, with dry type units up to 36 kV HSV and oil cooled units up to 145 kV HSV.

Our team brings over 25 years of experience in design, manufacturing and quality, serving utilities, private customers and switchgear manufacturers. We focus on reliable products, customer requirements and continual improvement.

Helpful answers

Frequently asked
questions.

From choosing a product to starting a conversation, find a little more clarity for your next project.

Have a different question?

Tell us about your application. Our team can help you take the next step.

01What products does ATIPL manufacture?

Our range includes current transformers (CTs), potential or voltage transformers (PTs/VTs), and CT/PT metering solutions, including metering cubicles. We offer indoor and outdoor product categories for electrical measurement, metering and protection. Explore our product range to find the relevant category.

02What is the difference between a CT and a PT?

A CT provides a scaled current signal, while a PT (also called a VT) provides a scaled voltage signal. Both serve compatible measurement and protection equipment. The right device depends on your application and specified ratings. Our CT vs PT guide explains the basics.

03Do you offer indoor and outdoor transformers?

Yes. ATIPL lists indoor and outdoor CTs and PTs in its product range. Share the installation location, available space and project specification so the team can review a suitable option. Read our indoor and outdoor application guide for an introduction.

04Can you review a custom transformer requirement?

Yes. Share your electrical requirements, interface drawings and application details with the ATIPL team. We can review your requirement and discuss a suitable configuration. The final design, ratings and supply scope are confirmed for the specific enquiry.

05What information should I include in an enquiry?

Include the product type, intended application, required primary and secondary values, accuracy and burden requirements, installation conditions and quantity. Attach your project specification and drawings where available, and mention the required delivery date. Our enquiry planning guide helps you bring these details together.

06Where can I find the product catalogue?

You can open our product catalogue (PDF, opens in a new tab) to explore the range and published specifications. For a project-specific selection, share the relevant requirements with our team.
